alex: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone: runtime v3 rollout status. Shipped: canary autoscale + metrics dashboard. Slipped: private VPC artifact packaging due to security review. Owners: eng-runtime: sanjay, product: maria. Need CRs, docs, and compliance signoff. Timeline: aiming end of next week if blocker cleared. pinging owners.
maria: ack. can you list the CRs that need priority? I'll coordinate with PMs and the board.
sanjay: main blocker = airgap CI failing image validation. security requested SBOM + hardened container config. I pushed a build-fix branch but need someone to own validation tests. PR is ready-ish.
jordan: I can take validation + first CR review. which PR?
sanjay: PR #4823 (infra-ci/packaging -> main). please add labels `priority/high` and `okr:v3`. also note there are flaky tests in test-image-verify.
alex: for labels, use this snippet when you open or update the PR:
```yaml
labels:
  - priority/high
  - okr:v3
  - owner:eng-runtime
```
liz: docs team can draft the packaging README and compliance checklist items. assign to @liz-docs and I'll triage content. we can reuse parts of the private-deploy runbook.
maria: I'll queue PR reviews, nudge security, and move cards. can we get a firm ship date if security signs off by Thu?
sanjay: if security signoff Thu morning, we can cut RC Thu evening and ship Fri EOD. backup: ship hosted/runtime-only and delay private VPC to next sprint if signoff stalls.
alex: action items: sanjay — attach SBOM + fix CI; jordan — validation + review PR #4823; liz — docs + checklist; maria — coordinate security signoff and board moves. I'll ping security and set a short standup if needed.
deploy-bot: canary autoscale rollout initiated on canary-2 (region us-west) at 1719123500 — health checks passing.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks. adding owners to calendar; tentative ship target 2024-07-12 if all green.
jordan: starting validation now, will post results on PR and here.
alex: :eyes: keep updates short, call out any blocker that would push private package out of the sprint.
sanjay: noted. will post SBOM link once uploaded to artifact store.
maria: pinging @security for signoff (cc @legal).
